opportunities.name: Look up a GitHub user profile by name
opportunities.description: Search GitHub for {person_name}, switch to the Users results tab, and open the matching user's profile.
steps: Click the GitHub header search box
Type the person's name or handle and press Enter
Click the 'Users' filter in the left sidebar
Click the matching user in the results
Review the profile page (pinned repos, followers, etc.)

instances.values: query='gaearon' (started from the nanoGPT repo page) -> dan / gaearon profile
query='simonw' (started from the react repo page) -> Simon Willison / simonw profile

opportunities.name: Compose and discard a draft in the New message form
opportunities.description: Open the New message form, fill in To, Subject, and Body with {recipient}, {subject}, and {body}, then click Discard.
opportunities.site: Local mail/compose web app (New message form)
steps: Click the To field and enter the recipient
Click the Subject field and enter the subject
Click the Body textarea and enter the message

instances.values: To/Subject/Body filled, then Discard (values not visible)
To/Subject/Body filled, then Discard (values not visible); followed the gaearon lookup
To/Subject/Body filled, then Discard (values not visible); followed the simonw lookup

opportunities.name: View an archived snapshot of a website in the Wayback Machine
opportunities.description: In the Wayback Machine, enter {site_url}, pick {year} on the timeline, choose a capture date on the calendar, and open the archived snapshot.
steps: Open web.archive.org (or use the URL box in the Wayback toolbar of an open snapshot)
Enter the site URL and press Enter
Click the target year on the capture timeline
Click a highlighted capture date in the calendar
Open and review the archived page; retry or reload when Error 429 appears

instances.values: site='microsoft.com', year=2014, capture around Jan 2014 (several 429 rate-limit errors)
site='beehive.govt.nz', typed into the toolbar of the 2014 Microsoft snapshot; interrupted by other tasks and resumed around 627, 767, and 898 (429 errors)
